feeds.title: Sew Sweetness Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sara, and I live with my husband and children in Chicago, Illinois. I started blogging in September of 2010 because I love sewing, and I am really inspired by the sewing community out in blogland. Sew Sweetness is your one stop shop for tutorials, awesome bag patterns, and more!

feeds.title: Andrie Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lisa, the face behind Andrie Designs - an indie pattern designer specialising detailed sewing patterns for professional results. Over the years I've dabbled in many different types of sewing projects which ultimately led me to starting my initial pattern business 'two pretty poppets'. Aptly named after my two darling daughters, it was a mix of handmade clothing and simple bag patterns.

feeds.title: Clover & Violet Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jennie. Mom to 3, quilter, pattern designer, bag maker, coffee drinker, planner lover & fabric hoader. Here I share quilt alongs tutorials, inspiration and a bit about my life.

feeds.title: Emmaline Bags
feeds.description: I'm Janelle, and I run a growing bag making supply and pattern design company up in the very cold areas of Canada. This is a blog offering sewing tutorials and patterns pertaining to handbags and purses. Emmaline is developing into a handy resource for the home sewer, bag maker and crafter.

feeds.title: Sew Some Stuff
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Javeriya! Science student, bag making addict and a collector of all things pink, sparkly and kawaii. And did I mention I'm also a fabric hoarder. A blog dedicated to all things sewing and bag making! A personal blog where I share my love of sewing. Learning day by day, improving step-by-step.

feeds.title: Supply 4 Bag Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog! we run a growing handbag & clutch making supply. This is a place to find info on free Sewing Tutorial Pattern, Handbag Hardware Update.

feeds.title: Projects by Jane
feeds.description: Covers articles about bag sewing patterns, handmade fabric bags. Jane is the brains and beauty behind Projects By Jane.

feeds.title: Craft Passion » Bag
feeds.description: Here you will get free crochet pattern to make a beautiful Kisslock Coin Purse. The crochet pattern comes in written instruction and photos. Beginner can do it.

feeds.description: Expert ideas and tutorials about fashion accessory design, creative bag design, construction techniques, do-it-yourself approaches, and more... from designer and educator Don Morin.
